“她一定有隐情！”

胡九郎在心中坚定地想着，也许她的背叛是被迫的，也许她有不得已的苦衷，也许她是为了保护他，才故意做出背叛的模样。

可无论是什么隐情，前世的他，终究受不了这份打击，跳崖身亡，这份遗憾和疑惑，如同一根刺扎在胡九郎的心底。

外界杨童紧紧守在胡九郎身边，看着他苍白的脸色，感受着他越来越微弱的呼吸，心都快要碎了。

李二牛已经离开了房间，去准备布置法坛的东西，临走前他再次叮嘱杨童，一旦决定，就再也没有回头的余地，轻则重伤，重则失血而亡。

杨童握着胡九郎冰冷的手，泪水无声地滑落，滴在他的手背上。

“九郎，你一定要坚持住，一定要等我。前世若是我真的背叛了你，那今生我便用我的命，来弥补你，来救你。无论付出什么代价，我都要让你醒过来。”

没过多久，李二牛便回来了，手中抱着一个木桌，还有香炉、香烛、黄符、朱砂，以及一把锋利的匕首。他将木桌放在房间中央，摆好香炉和香烛，点燃香烛，香烟袅袅升起，弥漫在房间内，驱散着残留的阴邪之气。

“丫头，你想好了吗？这个办法，就是你用杨家的血液作为祭品，祈求白仙的原谅。杨家的血液对五仙来说，有着特殊的意义，尤其是这种自愿献出的血液，更是充满了诚意，或许能感化白仙，让它收回阴寒之气，救胡九郎一命。”

杨童坚定道：

“我想好了！”

“有些话我必须要跟你说清楚，杨家的血液，与五仙有着很深的羁绊，自愿献祭，会损耗你的生机，若是失血过多，或者白仙依旧不肯原谅，你就会流血而亡，再也醒不过来，你再好好想想，不要一时冲动，后悔终生。”

杨童没有丝毫犹豫。

“李大哥，我想好了，我不后悔。只要能救九郎，我死而无憾。你开始吧。”

"She must have something hidden!"

Hu Jiulang thought firmly in his heart that maybe her betrayal was forced, maybe she had a last resort, maybe she deliberately acted like a betrayal in order to protect him.

But no matter what the secret was, he couldn't bear the blow in his previous life and jumped off a cliff to his death. This regret and doubt were like a thorn in Hu Jiulang's heart.

Outside, Yang Tong stayed close to Hu Jiulang, looking at his pale face and feeling his increasingly weak breathing, his heart almost broke.

Li Erniu had already left the room to prepare the things for the altar. Before leaving, he once again told Yang Tong that once he made a decision, there would be no room for turning back. It could range from serious injuries to death from blood loss.

Yang Tong held Hu Jiulang's cold hand, tears slipped silently and dripped on the back of his hand.

"Kuroro, you must hold on and wait for me. If I really betrayed you in the previous life, then in this life I will use my life to make up for you and save you. No matter what the cost, I will make you wake up."

Not long after, Li Erniu came back, holding a wooden table in his hands, as well as an incense burner, incense candles, yellow charms, cinnabar, and a sharp dagger.He placed the wooden table in the center of the room, set up the incense burner and incense candles, and lit the incense candles. The incense curled up and filled the room, dispersing the remaining evil spirit.

"Girl, have you thought about it? This method is to use the Yang family's blood as a sacrifice to pray for Bai Xian's forgiveness. The Yang family's blood has a special meaning to the Five Immortals, especially this voluntary donation of blood, which is full of sincerity. It may be able to influence the Bai Xian and let it take back the cold energy and save Hu Jiulang's life."

Yang Tong said firmly:

"I've thought about it!"

"I have to make something clear to you. The blood of the Yang family has a deep bond with the Five Immortals. Voluntary sacrifice will deplete your life. If you lose too much blood, or the White Immortal still refuses to forgive, you will bleed to death and never wake up. Think about it again, don't be impulsive and regret it for the rest of your life."

Yang Tong didn't hesitate at all.

"Brother Li, I have thought about it. I have no regrets. As long as I can save Jiulang, I will die without regrets. You start."
